notes: The Recreation and Park Commission's 1956 volume. Curated: the last 1947 bond contracts (Garfield and Rossi pools built without their buildings, Balboa Park's pool and center, Pine Lake), the Eureka Valley naming dispute and dedication, the North Beach pool's dedication, and the Columbus statue offer.

coverage.remaining: Routine items (repairs, zoo paddocks, golf course works, Camp Mather, Aquatic Park pier) not curated. The April 26 table of architects for the 1955 bond projects (Res. 2262) is unreadable in the OCR and was left out; read it from the scan if needed.

findings.address_as_written: Naming of new playground and recreation center at 19th and Collingwood
findings.description: After a supervisor proposed naming the new playground for Monsignor Leo W. Powleson and neighborhood groups asked to keep its planned name, the Recreation and Park Commission named it Eureka Valley Playground and named its baseball field in Father Powleson's honor, then set up a committee to handle future names.
